meta.title: Koushi — a desktop Matrix client for conversations in many languages
meta.description: Keep your work, personal, and community Matrix accounts open side by side. Encrypted chat, local full-text search that understands Japanese, Chinese, and Korean, and notifications sent from your own computer.
hero.tagline: A desktop Matrix client for conversations in many languages.
hero.lede: Keep your work, personal, and community Matrix accounts open side by side in one window. Each account has its own tab, stays signed in, and keeps syncing.
shot.main: Koushi with three account tabs above a three-pane workspace: Spaces, rooms, and a conversation with replies, reactions, and a thread.
matrix.heading: New to Matrix?
matrix.body: Matrix is an open chat network. Like email, you pick a server for your account and can still talk to people on other servers. Conversations can be end-to-end encrypted, and no single company owns the network.
matrix.account: No account yet? You can create one with any Matrix server; matrix.org is one public option.
pain.heading: Already on Matrix? Sound familiar?
pain.lede: Koushi grew out of everyday annoyances. If any of these bother you, it may be worth a try.
pain.accounts.problem: Signing out and back in to switch between work and personal accounts.
pain.accounts.answer: Add each account as a tab. Every tab stays signed in and syncing, shows its own unread count, and the composer always shows which account you are sending as.
pain.email.problem: Your homeserver never emails you about missed messages. matrix.org does not send notification email.
pain.email.answer: Koushi can send notifications itself, from your computer, by email through Resend or an SMTP relay, or to WeChat through ServerChan. You choose what triggers a notification, how much message text is included, and how long to wait before sending.
pain.email.shot: Notification settings listing destinations sent from this device: Resend, an SMTP relay, and WeChat.
pain.utd.answer: Koushi has you finish secure backup at sign-in, before you start chatting, and asks you to save the recovery key before you continue. When a missing key arrives later, the affected messages appear automatically. If backup fails, a diagnostics view tells you whether the network or the server is the problem. Nothing can recover keys that exist nowhere, but this design makes the error much rarer.
pain.search.problem: You can't find an old message in an encrypted room.
pain.search.answer: Koushi indexes your history on your own computer, including encrypted rooms, and searches across all rooms, one Space, or one conversation. Pick a result to jump to it in context.
pain.search.shot: Search results for “Koushi” from a Japanese room, an English room, and a room mixing Chinese, Korean, and English.
pain.multilingual.problem: Your rooms use different languages, or one room mixes several.
pain.multilingual.answer: Search does not need to know the language. Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and Latin-script text share one index, text without spaces between words is found, and full-width and half-width characters match each other.
pain.multilingual.shot: A search for リリース (release) also finds the half-width ﾘﾘｰｽ.
pain.ime.problem: Pressing Enter to confirm a Japanese, Chinese, or Korean conversion sends the message too early.
pain.ime.answer: In Koushi, confirming an input-method candidate is separate from sending. You can also choose whether Enter or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends.
pain.photos.problem: Phone photos are huge and slow to share.
pain.photos.answer: When you attach a large image, Koushi lets you choose the image quality before you send it.
pain.help.problem: You get lost in settings and help pages.
pain.help.answer: Ask ChatGPT or another AI assistant in your own language. Koushi's user guide is written so assistants can read it, and Help & About in the app shows you how to ask.
features.heading: Everyday features
features.e2ee: End-to-end encrypted chat, with sign-in through your browser (OIDC)
features.layout: A familiar three-pane layout: Spaces, rooms, and direct messages
features.timeline: Threads, replies, reactions, edits, and read receipts
features.rich: Markdown, code blocks, and LaTeX-style math
features.files: Image and file uploads with captions
features.desktop: System tray, close-to-hide, native notifications, and keyboard shortcuts
features.spaces: Suggested rooms in a Space, with an option to join them all at once
features.diagnostics: A diagnostics report you can save and share, without your message content
shot.rich: A conversation with Markdown formatting, a code block, and a math formula.
languages.heading: Five interface languages
languages.body: The app is available in English, 日本語, 简体中文, 繁體中文, and 한국어. Switch in App Settings → Appearance.
shot.languages: The Appearance settings with the language choice.
settings.heading: What you can configure
settings.body: Settings are split into App Settings, which apply to every account tab, and Account Settings for each account.
settings.app.appearance: App → Appearance: language, theme, density, UI font, and emoji style
settings.app.notifications: App → Notifications: OS notification sounds and badges, and destinations sent from this device
settings.app.preferences: App → Preferences: code-block wrapping, close to tray, loading older messages, thread placement
settings.app.keyboard: App → Keyboard: the send shortcut and a list of shortcuts
settings.app.search: App → Search history: background indexing speed, shared by all accounts
settings.account.account: Account → Account: display name, avatar, and password
settings.account.sessions: Account → Sessions: this device, verification, and sign-out
settings.account.notifications: Account → Notifications: desktop notifications, message previews, notifications sent from this device, and server rules
settings.account.privacy: Account → Security & Privacy: URL previews, read receipts, and typing notifications
settings.account.encryption: Account → Encryption: verification, secure backup, recovery, and room-key import/export
settings.account.search: Account → Search history: what gets indexed and per-room progress
settings.ask: For step-by-step help, ask an AI assistant or read the user guide.
shot.settings: The App Settings dialog with its category list.
missing.heading: Not included yet
missing.body: Voice and video calls, screen sharing, bots, widgets, and third-party app integrations.
platforms.heading: Platforms
platforms.body: macOS (Apple Silicon) is officially supported: releases are signed and notarized. Windows and Linux builds are produced by CI but are untested. If you use them and can help, contributions are welcome.
footer.translation: This page is available in five languages. Corrections from native speakers are welcome.
translating.note: Parts of this page are still being translated and are shown in English.
